integrity: Only the derived contiguous-ZIP exponential-weight endpoint optimization and corresponding local envelope are proposed as new. Existing general Stein identities, ratio statistics, normal theory, numerical weight optimization, and related covariance formulas are credited to prior authors.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive mean in the sample-size local limit, then separate mean-extreme optimizations; no assertion of finite-mean optimizer uniqueness, joint sample-size/mean limits, finite-sample uniform power, or global most-powerful tests. Originality remains subject to independent bibliographic confirmation, particularly older empirical-pgf literature.
title: Two endpoint scales for the locally optimal exponential Stein test of Poisson zero inflation
